title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
abstract: arXiv:2610.28489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. translated_title: 非对称循环Transformer：面向迭代解码器的固定全局表示
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享层来增加有效深度，提供了一种在不增加参数量的情况下扩展计算规模的途径。然而，全栈循环将上下文构建和迭代状态精炼置于同一个循环计算之中，没有明确区分两者的作用。我们提出了非对称循环Transformer（AsymLoop），它将单次通过的上下文编码与循环状态精炼分离开来。一个单次通过的自回归编码器生成各层特定的全局键值缓存，这些缓存在整个迭代过程中保持固定；而一个权重绑定的循环解码器则从其不断演进的状态中生成局部键值。在单一softmax下对这两个来源进行联合注意力，使每次更新都能将持久的上下文信息与当前的中间状态整合起来。在训练方面，我们对编码器和解码器应用了一种重尾引导的逐层学习率方法。在FineWeb上的实验……
tldr: 提出非对称循环Transformer（AsymLoop），将单次上下文编码与循环状态精炼解耦，利用迭代过程中保持固定的全局KV缓存与循环解码器生成的局部KV进行联合注意力，从而在不增加参数量的情况下提升模型的有效深度。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which decouples single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement by combining iteration-invariant Global KV caches from a causal encoder with Local KV from a weight-tied recurrent decoder under joint attention, increasing effective depth without extra parameters.
